title: Everyone Panics During Earnings Season. 13 Years of VIX Data Says Don't Bother.
description:
Every quarter the financial media treats earnings season like it is going to blow up the VIX. Thirteen years of data says it is much ado about nothing.

The VIX is priced off the S&P 500. When one stock has a massive earnings move, the other 499 dilute the signal completely. The number of times the VIX made a new high during earnings season versus outside of it: 26 versus 24. The average VIX during earnings: 19. Outside earnings: 17. Statistically the same. Tony and Ryan walk through all four slides of the study and explain what this actually means for how you trade the overall market around earnings.
